title: Michael Rulli Sold $50K–$100K of Alphabet Stock (Oct 2026)
content:
Rep. Michael Rulli (OH-6) disclosed the sale of $50,001–$100,000 of Alphabet Class C (GOOG) stock on October 19, 2026, dated October 16, along with a $1,001–$15,000 sale of WesBanco (WSBC).

Trade data: Bargo, compiled from U.S. House and Senate STOCK Act filings.

DateTickerCompanyType / sizePrice at trade vs. Oct 30 (Bargo est.)
Oct 16GOOGAlphabet Inc.Sale, $50,001–$100,000$336.91 vs. $278.22 (−17.42%)
Oct 16WSBCWesBanco, Inc.Sale, $1,001–$15,000$37.22 vs. $38.49 (+3.41%)

Transaction date for both: Oct 16, 2026. Disclosure date: Oct 19, 2026 (3 days later). Member: Rep. Michael Rulli, OH-6 (House).

What's been disclosed

  • Alphabet Class C sale: $50,001–$100,000 on October 16.
  • WesBanco sale: $1,001–$15,000 on October 16.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts Alphabet about 17.4% lower on October 30 than on the sale date and WesBanco about 3.4% higher.
  • Related filings: the same member's earlier disclosure of a Microsoft sale is in this post.

Quick FAQ

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
3 days after the trades, which were both dated October 16. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the October 30 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.
